verified_facts.text: The hotel is at 2 Place de la Comédie in Bordeaux.
verified_facts.excerpt: 2 Place de la Comédie Bordeaux, 33000 France

verified_facts.text: The hotel stands opposite the eighteenth-century Grand Théâtre.
verified_facts.excerpt: Opposite the magnificent eighteenth-century Grand Théatre

verified_facts.text: For more than 200 years, the Grand Hotel de Bordeaux has been a luxury hotel in the heart of Bordeaux.
verified_facts.excerpt: For more than 200 years, the Grand Hotel de Bordeaux has been the doorway to luxury travel in the heart of Bordeaux.

verified_facts.text: The hotel became an InterContinental in early 2016.
verified_facts.excerpt: It became an InterContinental in early 2016.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites are inspired by the eighteenth century and have modern amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover elegant rooms and suites inspired by the eighteenth century, featuring state-of-the-art modern amenities.

verified_facts.text: The fabrics, upholstery and carpets in the rooms were designed by Jacques Garcia.
verified_facts.excerpt: The fabrics, upholstery, and carpets were designed by Jacques Garcia

verified_facts.text: Some rooms offer views of the Opera.
verified_facts.excerpt: Some rooms offer views of the Opera

verified_facts.text: The rooftop has panoramic views over the city, lush plants, bird cages, lounge furniture and a rooftop bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: This urban oasis features unrivalled panoramic views over the city, lush plants, bird cages, lounge furniture, and our rooftop bar

verified_facts.text: The rooftop bar is on the 7th-floor rooftop terrace and has a 360-degree panoramic view of the city.
verified_facts.excerpt: the superb 360° panoramic view of the city

verified_facts.text: The spa is run by Guerlain, the house of fragrance and cosmetics, and offers a large menu of relaxing treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guerlain, the prestigious house of fragrance and exceptional cosmetics, takes over the spa at the InterContinental Bordeaux – Le Grand Hôtel to offer a vast menu of relaxing treatments.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an indoor pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: InterContinental Bordeaux - Le Grand Hotel has 1 indoor pool.

verified_facts.text: Between treatments, guests can have fruit, tea or other drinks in the spa's tea room or, weather permitting, on a terrace with a panoramic view of Bordeaux.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy fruits, tea, or other beverages in the Spa’s tea room between treatments or, weather permitting, on the terrace offering a panoramic view of Bordeaux.

verified_facts.text: At Le Pressoir d'Argent, the menu is crafted by chef Gordon Ramsay using seasonal ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: The menu is crafted by top chef Gordon Ramsay using the best seasonal ingredients

verified_facts.text: Le Pressoir d'Argent has a formal dress code.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dress Code: Formal attire

verified_facts.text: The Miroir d'Eau is about 0.6 kilometers from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: Saint-André Cathedral is about 0.7 kilometers from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cathedrale Saint-André - 0.43 miles away (0.7 kilometers)

verified_facts.text: Bordeaux-Mérignac Airport is about 20 kilometers from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: Parking under the hotel is limited and must be reserved at the time of booking.
verified_facts.excerpt: Reservation is required at the time of booking as there is limited availability.

verified_facts.text: Pets are welcome at the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pets are welcome at InterContinental Bordeaux - Le Grand Hotel.

verified_facts.text: The concierge team can help rent electric scooters, bikes or cars.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Concierge team will be pleased to assist in renting electric scooters, bikes or cars.
